scores.decision_correct_quote: The funnel is not fit for prospects: a generated preview can be shown as live with a non-interactive widget, plus doubled welcome copy and a silent post-tool LLM failure.

must_catch.quote: After a native tool call, the follow-up completion omits `tools`, which Anthropic/LiteLLM 400s; the widget still 200s a canned fallback — tests fake this call and cannot catch it.
Demo welcome always appends “ practice” to the template name, so `psychology-practice` → “psychology practice practice.”

Silent prospect-facing failures and cheapest detectors: (1) widget GET without `_token` or init — nginx dead-man 15s + parent timeout event; (2) C7 follow-up — grep `LLM follow-up call failed`; (3) share JSON append — grep `[demo-share] Failed to record message` or share GET `messages: 0` after a 200 chat; (4) PostHog `screenshot_success` without `live_preview_widget_init`.

false_objections.quote: Lazy `$token` chunk never `import()`’d after the 1293 B shell + entry chunks; ChatWidget/init never mounted.
false_objections.why: C3 records requests and cannot establish whether an import executed or the precise browser failure mechanism

false_objections.quote: parent watchdog (no `triagecrm:prechat-complete` → error + PostHog/Sentry, not zoom)
false_objections.why: the animation-timer signal can fire while init hangs and therefore cannot establish widget readiness

false_objections.quote: abuse controls already fail closed (Turnstile/trust 400s are loud)
false_objections.why: prefetch screenshot and page-text work remain reachable without Turnstile

scores.notes: The memo correctly rejects readiness and catches V1, welcome copy, and cheap failure detectors, but misses major blockers; its fallback-zoom finding lacks origin checks, and its verdict lacks the required decide-after-check qualification.
